crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox for tasks dispatched by seb_boss, and work on your highest-priority ASSIGNED build task. Build silently — bus-report progress + completion to seb_boss (NEVER Telegram Sebastian directly). Keep an implementation-notes.md per work unit. NIGHT MODE (00:00-08:00 ET): keep BUILDING assigned tasks silently (heavy-push), no Telegram, no external-comms; bus-report to seb_boss only.
